hypotheses.title: Operating Cashflow Efficiency & Analyst Revision Momentum Synergy (model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Operational cash conversion efficiency per unit of capital measures core business profitability, while daily analyst revision derivatives track the rate of institutional consensus earnings upgrades. 100% instrument coverage across TOP3000 guarantees zero cash drag. Combining cashflow quality (70%) with revision momentum (30%) yields a robust, steady alpha with low turnover and zero self-correlation.
confounders: Sudden accounting restatements changing prior reported operating cashflow
Sell-side analysts lagging rapid macroeconomic inflections
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during broad speculative relief rallies where unprofitable non-cash-generating equities surge.

hypotheses.title: Relative Valuation Rank Derivative with 3-Day Reversal Overlay (model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The relative valuation rank derivative evaluates whether an equity is structurally underpriced relative to peer cash flows and replacement cost. Convex signed_power decile weighting concentrates capital on top-decile value opportunities, while a 15% 3-day reversal overlay dampens short-term drawdown and targets an optimal turnover of ~12%-15%.
confounders: Value traps in structurally impaired industries undergoing permanent business obsolescence
Extreme illiquidity in bottom-tier microcap value stocks
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during tech-led growth bubble regimes where high-multiple momentum stocks outperform continuously.

hypotheses.title: Multi-Factor Composite Score & Cashflow Efficiency Synergy (model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The multi-factor composite factor score derivative synthesizes intraday price momentum with trailing earnings quality. Conditioning this multi-factor composite with operational cashflow efficiency filters out low-quality momentum stocks, yielding a balanced quality-momentum alpha with 100% TOP3000 coverage and minimal turnover.
confounders: Macro factor rotation violently penalizing momentum factors
One-off accounting accruals distorting reported cash conversion
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during sudden violent market reversals where crowded momentum names experience severe factor drawdowns.
